definitions.explanation: Official agreement or permission for something to proceed.
Formal acceptance of something as valid or legitimate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{承認|しょうにん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}て→得る：02014_eru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{進|すす}めて→進める：01949_susumeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please proceed after obtaining your supervisor's approval.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新薬|しんやく}→新薬：28055_shinyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{承認|しょうにん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: It takes time to get approval for a new drug.

examples.japanese: ⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{承認|しょうにん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|お}りた→下りる：00568_oriru⟧⟦ので→ので：noentry⟧、⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開始|かいし}→開始：02537_kaishi⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Now that the budget has been approved, we can start the project.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国連|こくれん}→国連：12035_kokuren⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{承認|しょうにん}した→承認する：20064_shouninsuru⟧。
examples.english: The United Nations recognized the new government.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{承認|しょうにん}されて→承認する：20064_shouninsuru⟧⟦いない→いる：00495_iru⟧。

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{功績|こうせき}→功績：04143_kouseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ようやく→ようやく：00429_youyaku⟧⟦{承認|しょうにん}され→承認する：20064_shouninsuru⟧、⟦{表彰|ひょうしょう}→表彰：17400_hyoushou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: His achievements were finally recognized and he received an award.

notes:
{承認|しょうにん} refers to formal approval or official recognition. Common in business, government, and legal contexts.

SENSE 1 - APPROVAL:
Giving official permission for something to proceed. Used for budgets, projects, proposals, and regulatory approvals.

SENSE 2 - RECOGNITION:
Formally acknowledging something as valid or legitimate. Used for governments, qualifications, and achievements.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {承認|しょうにん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧: to obtain approval
- {承認|しょうにん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧: to seek approval
- {承認|しょうにん}⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧: approval process
- ⟦{事前|じぜん}→事前：07580_jizen⟧{承認|しょうにん}: prior approval

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{認可|にんか}→認可：05879_ninka⟧: authorization, licensing (official/regulatory)
- ⟦{許可|きょか}→許可：00259_kyoka⟧: permission (granting right to do something)
- ⟦{同意|どうい}→同意：05092_doui⟧: agreement, consent (between parties)

WATCH OUT:
⟦{商人|しょうにん}→商人：03236_shounin⟧ (merchant) shares the same reading but has completely different kanji and meaning.
